ledger: Man in bathroom (foreground and mirror reflection) | Dark combed-back hair, clean-shaven/light stubble, wearing an unbuttoned white collared dress shirt, standing in front of a wooden-framed bathroom mirror facing his reflection | Same wardrobe and standing position at end | At 00:02-00:03 his facial features in the mirror reflection morph noticeably as he tilts his head down; at 00:07-00:09 his right hand and arm position in the foreground diverge from his pose in the mirror reflection

findings.description: As the man tilts his head downward between 00:02 and 00:03, his facial structure in the mirror reflection—specifically the shape of his eyes, brow, and nose bridge—morphs into a noticeably different face before reverting to his original facial features by 00:04-00:05.

findings.entity: Man in bathroom (foreground vs. mirror reflection)
findings.description: From 00:07 to 00:09, the man's arm and hand placement in the foreground do not match his reflection in the mirror: in the foreground his right hand moves outward to hover in mid-air to the side of his cheek, while in the mirror reflection his hand remains held directly in front of his mouth and chin.
